notes.title: Fully support XBOX controller
notes.content:
Using cross platform input technology instead of the original fixed keyboard key input, now the game fully supports the game controller including Xbox controller.

Optimized the game.

Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Player strengthen, unique skill release tips, Optimized
notes.content:
The player has been strengthened, the game has become not so difficult to accomplish like that. 
Added a unique skill release tips.
Optimized the game and fixed bugs.
